profile: AI Engineering Lead managing a bloated enterprise LLM stack. Heavy coding (60%), research (25%), documentation (15%). Running Opus 4.6/4.7, GPT-4o, and GPT-5.5 on trivial tasks that do not need frontier models. 15+ daily searches, compress every session, use skills 10x/day. Target: cut cost by 90% while preserving reasoning quality on heavy tasks.
profile_detail: Enterprise Bloated Stack before HAA: GPT-5.5 at $5/$30 on Session Search, Opus 4.6 at $5/$25 on Approval, GPT-4o at $2.50/$10 on Title Gen. After HAA: 6 tasks move to Llama-3.2-3B:Free ($0.00), remaining 5 on Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite at $0.25/$1.50. Estimated monthly saving: $100-150.

tasks.name: Default Chat
tasks.rationale: SWITCH: Opus 4.6 at $5/$25 per 1M tokens is 20x more expensive than Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite for conversational AI. Flash Lite handles chat at $0.25/$1.50 with identical quality. Only use Opus if deep multi-step reasoning is critical for the conversation.

tasks.name: Vision Analysis
tasks.rationale: SWITCH: GPT-4o at $2.50/$10 per 1M tokens is overkill for Telegram screenshots and debugging images. Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite handles vision natively at $0.25/$1.50 with 1M context -- 10x cost reduction with identical accuracy.

tasks.name: Web Extract
tasks.rationale: SWITCH: GPT-4o at $2.50/$10 for web scraping and content extraction is 10x more expensive than necessary. Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite reads pages at $0.25/$1.50 with 1M context. Savings compound with 10+ daily extractions.

tasks.name: Compression
tasks.rationale: SWITCH: Opus 4.6 at $5/$25 for session compression is pure budget waste. Ring 2.6-1t:free is a zero-cost thinking model designed exactly for this task. No quality difference for log summarization -- only cost savings.

tasks.name: Session Search
tasks.rationale: SWITCH: GPT-5.5 at $5/$30 per 1M tokens for basic search and retrieval is a 2000x cost premium with zero quality gain. Llama-3.2-3B:Free delivers identical retrieval accuracy at $0.00/$0.00. At 15+ queries per day, this single task switch saves approximately $60-80 per month. Latency drops from 800ms+ to sub-100ms. This is the highest-impact SWITCH in the entire pipeline.

tasks.name: Skills Hub
tasks.rationale: SWITCH: 10x/day skill matching on Opus 4.6 burns budget silently. Free 3B handles text retrieval instantly at $0.00/$0.00. No model quality gap for simple keyword matching and skill retrieval tasks.

tasks.name: Approval
tasks.rationale: SWITCH: Shell approval checks do not need frontier reasoning. Free 3B responds in sub-100ms vs GPT-5.5 at 800ms+. Safety logic is identical. Zero cost and faster -- immediate ROI on every approval call.

tasks.name: MCP Tooling
tasks.rationale: SWITCH: GPT-4o at $2.50/$10 for tool trace analysis is 10x more expensive than Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite. 1M context is preserved. Tool output parsing does not benefit from GPT-4o's multimodal upgrades.

tasks.name: Title Generation
tasks.rationale: SWITCH: Generating session titles with GPT-4o is a budget drain with zero ROI. Free 3B handles trivial naming at $0.00/$0.00. Title quality is identical. Every dollar spent on GPT-4o for title generation is pure waste.

tasks.name: Triage Specifier
tasks.rationale: SWITCH: Gemini 3.1 Pro at $2/$12 is 8x more expensive than Flash Lite for repository routing. Context window is identical at 1M. Flash Lite handles triage classification with 8x less cost and faster latency.

tasks.name: Curator
tasks.rationale: SWITCH: Opus 4.7 at $5/$25 for memory pruning is excessive. DeepSeek V3.1 provides strong instruction-following for pruning logic at $0.15/$0.75 -- 33x cheaper than Opus 4.7 with comparable task alignment.
